# Project Notes

## Overview
This document describes the project structure and configuration.
Run the tool with the --verbose flag for more detail.
The build is triggered automatically on every commit to the main branch.

## Paths
- The build script is at C:\tools\build.ps1
- The asset pipeline is at /opt/deploy/config.yaml
- The output directory is E:\dev\output\bin
- The editor is at C:\Program Files\Engine\Unity.exe

## Configuration
Set the environment to production before deploying.
Logs are written to the standard location and rotated weekly.
